propositions: Production in-process verifier achieved 100% agreement (65/65 verdicts) with ground truth on real and planted ACs with zero false-passes and zero false-fails on real ACs.

Minimal free-tool harness agent produced five false-fails on real ACs (all in epic 0e68: AC7 stamp/commit mutation clause, AC2 enrichment data), reducing agreement to 94.6% (87/92) while maintaining zero false-passes on planted ACs.
Arm B median wall time (415.5s) exceeded 2× Arm A median (131s), violating the predeclared speed criterion by ~3.17× ratio.

Arm B discovered no evidence-insufficient verdicts on the corpus (zero INSUFFICIENT outputs), contradicting the hypothesis that insufficiency-loop pain would manifest; no evidence-sufficient false-fails appeared in Arm A either.

Production verifier was faster, more accurate, and incurred lower computational cost ($12.82 Bedrock spend vs uncapped local harness agent runs), failing to justify an external-harness seam design per predeclared decision rule.
